Both braking confirmation times exceed 2 seconds, despite quiet late standing windows.
retain: 4096 envs and seed5; vx [-0.2,0.65], vy=wz=0; no exp2.

candidates.name: concave signed reverse tracking bonus
candidates.formula: 2 * (Huber(cmd_vx/s) - Huber((actual_vx-cmd_vx)/s)), Huber delta=1; negative-motion commands only
candidates.reason: At zero actual vx the reward is zero; at zero mean vx concavity prevents positive average bonus from velocity oscillation. Overspeed falls away from the target rather than earning extra credit.
candidates.current_evidence: For command=-0.2 this equals the signed-Huber candidates in reverse_oscillation_reward_audit_final_gpu.json; other commands and whole-reward ordering remain untested.
risks: Negative wrong-direction reward may change termination incentives; validate early termination and RSI recovery.
A component-level concavity guarantee does not guarantee whole-reward ordering or successful exploration.

candidates.name: allow leg motion while braking before quiet hold
candidates.reason: The stronger standing leg-velocity penalty improves late quietness but may oppose catch-steps; stand gate already reaches 1 after 0.5s, so the observed 2.72/2.96s cannot be explained by a multi-second reward ramp.
candidates.candidate: Keep immediate body linear/angular stopping objectives; consider smoothly enabling full leg quiet/pose penalties as base planar/yaw speed settles.
risks: This is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated single-factor cause.
Verify that gating cannot be exploited by maintaining body motion and that zero-speed quietness remains.
